newsitem.title: USA: Universal City, Calif. development report released.
newsitem.headline: Universal City, Calif. development report released.

text.p: Los Angeles County on Tuesday released the draft environmental impact report for a multi-billion-dollar development plan by MCA Inc.
The 25-year plan outlines proposed developments within MCA's 415-acre Universal City property in Los Angeles.
Currently, MCA's motion picture and television production facilities, Universal Studios Hollywood theme park among other entertainment-related businesses are located on the property.
MCA Inc is a unit of the Seagram Co Ltd, the global beverage and entertainment company.
The multi-billion-dollar plan includes a cluster of resort hotels and recreation facilities, MCA said.

The release of the draft environmental impact report begins the two-month public review and comment period, which extends through December 20. A series of public hearings will also be held in the city and county of Los Angeles.
MCA said the development could result in $1.6 billion in new economic activity and could generate new city and county tax revenues in excess of $25 million per year.
The development is also expected to create thousands of new jobs.
